token_interpretation.caution: The 3.38% supervised/full-input ratio does not dilute loss: model loss is normalized over supervised tokens only. Token-count fractions are exposure diagnostics, not measured gradient contributions. Conditional copy success does not establish copy accuracy for refused examples.

confirmed: All observed answerable failures are action-selection failures, not malformed output or wrong value/citation conditional on emitting answer.
The budget+missing-plan heuristic agrees with most model actions.
All-product mention and equal-official-value cues are one-sided perfect answer indicators in current train/dev.
Sampler replays actual logged supervised-token totals without missing answer classes.
Prompt/target projection and public-rule agreement have no observed label inconsistency.
not_proven: Attention or gradient contribution of action tokens is not measured.
No claim that forced-answer decoding would copy correctly on refused examples.
No evidence yet that class weighting, a larger model, a different serialization or more steps fixes the defect.
Historical test is now diagnostic data; it cannot remain a fresh V3 holdout.
